# ESP Web Tools 10.4.0

The browser flasher used by `../index.html`, copied unchanged from the npm package `esp-web-tools@10.4.0` (folder `dist/web`),
so the page does not load code from a third-party server.

- Source: https://github.com/esphome/esp-web-tools
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`)
- npm tarball SHA-256: `f18da75335d2f0dca044c4bb052848c0696e7b03cc23d61d8530dd6eba0a9008`

To update, download the newer package, replace the `.js` files in this folder and test flashing on a radio.
